verdict.rationale: Kick's Activity tab is explicitly documented as a full audit trail logging every transaction change, categorization update, and sync event with timestamp and the actor (including AI agents), which directly satisfies the accountant's need to trace who changed what and when (kick-supp-audit-trail, kick-docs-10). Multi-entity support and locked-period protections reinforce ledger integrity across entities (kick-docs-5, kick-docs-19, kick-supp-locks). Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the audit log aggregates/spans across multiple entities in one consolidated view (vs. per-entity logs), and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
